subject: northern goshawk
title: This Hawk Kills Hares Twice Its Weight, and Chases Them on Foot

scenes.text: This hawk kills animals twice its weight, and doesn't give up when they hide.
The goshawk weaves between tree trunks at up to twenty-five miles an hour.
It takes snowshoe hares more than twice its own weight.
If prey dives into a thicket, it lands and chases on foot. It's even followed prey into water.
And near its nest, it attacks people who wander too close.
Hiding works on most hawks. This one walks in after you.

description:
Goshawks hunt through forest at up to about 40 km/h and can kill mammals more than twice their own weight, such as snowshoe hares.
They sometimes chase prey on foot through brush or into water, and they fiercely defend their nests, even against people.
Would you walk past a goshawk nest?
first_comment: Female goshawks are nearly twice as heavy as males. Which bird of prey should we cover next?
